help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Reduces the slotted power's recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%. Additionally, in PvE the slotted power will have a chance to fear targets, and if those targets are awoken from their nightmare while feared they will take moderate psionic damage. In PvP the slotted power will have a chance to deal moderate psionic damage. This enhancement's chance to trigger is equal to approximately 3.5 times per minute.
power_display_names: Superior Endless Nightmare: Recharge/Chance for Fear, Psionic Damage If Woke Early
power_short_helps: Increases Recharge, Chance for Fear, Psionic Damage if woke early from the Nightmare
